payload.credit_html: Neutron scanning reveals unexpected complexity in the enamel thickness of an herbivorous Jurassic reptile (http://rsif.royalsocietypublishing.org/content/15/143/20180039)
payload.description_html: The left posteriormost tooth of Eilenodon (DMNH EPV.10685). (a) Anterior and (b) posterior stereopairs of the unworn isolated dentary tooth. (c) Anterodorsal view of a partial left dentary showing the apical and labial wear facets. Scale bar = 2 mm.
